title: Phage Functional Protein Discovery — Candidate Database v2.0 (噬菌体功能蛋白 AI 发现 候选数据库 v2.0)
description:
A prediction-level, reproducible resource for phage antibacterial proteins (depolymerases, endolysins, holins).

What's new in v2.0 (on top of the v1.0 candidate database of 4,117 entries):

  • D1 — sequence-level AI prediction: ESM-2 (650M) and ProtT5-XL embeddings with leakage-free evaluation on a cluster-disjoint frozen split. Three-family classification macro-F1 0.996–0.997; antibacterial vs. background-decoy AUROC 0.993 (ESM-2) / 0.998 (ProtT5), AUPRC 0.973 / 0.994 vs. a 3-mer baseline (0.21).
  • D4 — structural strictification: PDB2PQR(AMBER/PROPKA)+APBS(LPBE) strict electrostatic surfaces (grid auto-enclosing elongated 160–260 Å β-helix depolymerases) and 37-sequence-MSA conservation surfaces for five Class-1B enzymes.
  • D5 — host/serotype linking: Kaptive (7 A. baumannii genomes) and PAst/PAST (6 P. aeruginosa genomes).
  • D6 — full-library novelty: 522 queries searched against the entire AlphaFold DB (~200 M sequences) by DIAMOND — 95.8% have a substantial homolog, only 0.6% are true singletons; dbCAN assigns a CAZy family to 20.7% (dominated by GH90), with 45.0% having no CAZy hit. Novelty is framed at the functional level.

Contents: data/ (candidate DB v2.0 CSV+SQLite, frozen splits, D6 tables), results/ (D1/D4/D5/D6 outputs and figures), code/ (reproducible scripts), figs/ (manuscript figures), web/ (deployable FastAPI search app), docs/ (methods + reproduction).

All entries are in-silico predictions; substrates and catalytic residues are inferred and require wet-lab validation.
